record.question: The minimum age for a candidate to become a member of Rajya Sabha is:
record.explanation: Answer C: 30. Article 84(b) sets the minimum age for Rajya Sabha membership at 30 years. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
